flags.name: DSV41_RDMA_PROJ
flags.meaning: HT13 (needs DSV41_RDMA_TRIM=1 and RDMA_AR_EXT = the r7 .so): while dsv41_oblit has armed a direction, a bf16 [rows <= 6, 5120] rdma all-reduce also writes y = _proj_rows(out, d) in its tail; dsv41_oblit.project(out, d) returns y. Values 0/1/off/on/false/true/no/yes, else a startup error. Refused at import (dsv41_oblit) together with DSV41_GLUE_PDL enabling 'proj' or with DSV41_OBLIT_FOLD. Logs 'rdma_ar-r7 fwd: capturing=.. fwd_rows=.. folded=.. taken=.. wasted=..' per captured forward.

HT13.note: estimates/estimates7.py from ht13_t2c (t2, all 6 traces): 76.00 armed rdma ARs/step, 75.98 folds taken, wasted folds 0.022/step (the Engram AR is a gather, mode 3, and never folds); consumer slack: low = every consumer delay beyond the 0.26 us dependent-launch latency read as another dependency (tail 2.7 us), central = only delays > L + 1 us (14.8 % of pairs; tail 1.6 us), high = naive gap + dur - tail (tail 0.8 us). The tail is a model; projtime (INFO) measures it; only C-T-C-T decides. First estimate was 0.21 / 0.61 / 0.90 (no waste, no slack).
